notes: Tiny, scheming, cruel. A genuine tyrant, Caligula-type: doesn't understand the importance of reciprocity and kindness. Tyrant of Great Tottering. Kit (Princeling): low stats, a fearsome support kit; his damage is spells, and the rapier pierces rather than hits hard; his men take his hits and his debuffs (Entourage, Blame) and pay for his boons (Decimate); hurt him and the scheming stops (Panic).
